queries_run: Tutor Perini market share competition backlog 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 稱近年大型固定價格土木基建案競爭者減少，業主有時需努力吸引投標者；Civil 主要對手含 FlatironDragados、Kiewit、Lane、OHL USA、Skanska、Walsh。
findings.excerpt: We have seen diminished competition in recent years for large, fixed-price civil infrastructure projects as fewer firms have been pursuing such projects and customers have at times had to make concerted efforts to attract bidders.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：競爭激烈，失敗可能降低市占與利潤；漸進式設計建造趨勢可能增加競爭、壓低部分案件毛利。
findings.excerpt: If we are unable to compete successfully in such markets, our relative market share and profits could be reduced. In addition, evolving changes in the construction industry, such as the trend toward an increased use of the progressive design-build project delivery method that may reduce project risks for both owners and contractors, could result in increased competition and potentially lower margins on certain projects in the future.

note: 未搜到同業市占消長的第三方數據；僅一手文件。
